note: Mixed provenance. Fixtures with source=capture are derived from a real Google Maps capture on Android 16 (2026-07-13); street names and destinations are replaced with placeholders, but the FIELD STRUCTURE is real — note the ETA in subText ('Arrive 23:51') on every navigation notification. Fixtures with source=synthetic were authored from documented notification patterns. See rules/fixtures/README.md.
